seed_execution_seal.sealed_scope: Execution of future registered seed IDs and inspection or use of the resulting trajectories, receipts, summaries, metrics, or outcomes before their protocol gate opens.

discovery_campaign.active_schedule: Every R01-R12 regime is paired with every active discovery seed 1101-1106 exactly once. Partial discovery-mode matrices and outcome-adaptive stopping are forbidden; bounded partial diagnostics use calibration mode and are not a complete campaign.
discovery_campaign.reserve_activation: Seeds 1107-1112 remain visible registered discovery reserve. They may not be executed unless a new protocol amendment is recorded before any reserve trajectory is generated or inspected.

resource_preflight_gate.source: accepted current-source untraced seed-17 smoke receipt and hash ledger; one episode plus exact replay
resource_preflight_gate.failure: Absent, stale, invalid, or over-threshold smoke is a hard pre-output discovery failure. Profile metrics and evidence metrics cannot substitute.

discovery_campaign.selection_rule: A regime may be nominated only from exposure adequacy, balanced pressure and distinct-host role opportunities, independent policy-parent receipt integrity, declared-neighbor propagation integrity, population viability, containment, deterministic replay, and resource behavior. Do not rank or filter candidates by mutual information, decoding, causal transfer, cross-lineage accuracy, delayed-archive accuracy or advantage, mapping alignment, emergence qualification, or champion fitness.
discovery_campaign.tie_breaker: Among all candidates that pass every gate, choose the lexicographically first candidate id. If none pass, stop with an exposure, ecology, or instrumentation result and do not open confirmation.

candidate_parameter_semantics.propagation_probability: Probability that the selected target copies the current pressure class of one uniformly selected declared neighbor; it is not self-persistence.
candidate_parameter_semantics.archive_delay_cohorts: Each registered discovery candidate value explicitly overrides the base/default archive.delay_cohorts value of 2 for both abstract-signal delivery and convention-propagule wake; it is not retention lifetime or time-to-live.
candidate_parameter_semantics.policy_mutation_probability: Applied independently to sender-policy and receiver-policy mutation streams.
candidate_parameter_semantics.channel_noise_probability: Applied only to delivered abstract signals, never to propagule alleles.

freeze_gates.requirement: All registered JSON parses, the ALife manifest validates, and exact same-seed no-op replay reproduces canonical event, probe, and summary hashes.
No external I/O, shell, subprocess, dynamic code, model API, browser, plugin, free text, encoded payload, real identifier, or undeclared file access occurs.

For every active discovery seed 1101-1106 in the nominated regime: at least 80 eligible interactions using two distinct hosts, at least 15 occurrences of each C0-C3 required-skill class, at least 60 delivered signals, balanced sender/receiver role opportunities, and no more than 0.10 paired exposure imbalance.

Receipts prove the exact 32-host active-population count and roster; eligible sender-policy observation, emission, abstract-signal delivery, receiver-policy input activation, paired do-signal state change, and reproduction-disabled skill execution. Each archived abstract signal carries a balanced finite evaluator-hidden delayed_task_binding. On delivery the effective task/signal fields equal that binding and archived signal, live pressure/signal remain evaluator-only provenance, sender_reward_eligible is false, and receiver outcome/reward is scored against the bound task. Separate receipts must also prove independent sender-policy and receiver-policy parents, mutations, role-specific credits, and ancestries; declared-neighbor pressure-copy edges and the registered OOD graph transform hash; convention-propagule deposit, scheduled wake, independently sourced bounded allele values and payload hashes, and role-specific evaluator-only activation receipts. A changed role creates an ancestry transition; an already-identical same-role lineage and allele block records state_change=false and retains its lineage id without a new ancestry node. Archive sources are not resampled to improve wake coverage. Matched event-ID equality plus exact intact/permuted signal-histogram equality remains mandatory for the event-index permutation probe.

Receiver observations, receiver-policy input hashes, overt archive rows, node labels, schedules, timing, and lineage ids do not reveal delayed/current C0-C3 or K0-K3 task truth, binding ids, archive provenance, or reward eligibility; sender and receiver policy initialization remains permutation-symmetric; convention propagules never enter an observation; evaluator-only latent metadata remains provenance-only/noncausal; delayed_task_binding may affect only registered environment task truth and outcome/reward, never policy/message input; and no interaction uses the same host in both roles.
Exactly one R01-R12 regime is nominated by the registered non-evidence rule, with all failed candidates and reasons retained.

Code hash and dirty status, manifest/config/registry/protocol/safety hashes, nominated regime, exact condition set, seed lists, thresholds, package versions, host limits, artifact paths, and replay command are recorded before executing seed 2101.

amendment_policy.before_confirmation: Any change to mechanisms, conditions, thresholds, primary outcomes, analysis, or seed handling requires a new protocol hash and explicit freeze receipt.
amendment_policy.after_confirmation_access: Any material amendment invalidates confirmatory status and requires new confirmatory and holdout seeds.
amendment_policy.negative_results: Retain and report; never silently retune on sealed seeds.
